payload.title: Comment on: cytotoxicity of repurposed antivirals in hepatic lines
payload.abstract: The recent report of antiviral cytotoxicity in Huh7 cells raises a methodological question that we believe warrants comment. The authors normalised viability to a vehicle control containing 0.5 per cent dimethyl sulfoxide, but their highest compound concentrations required 1 per cent. Solvent alone reduces viability in this line by a measurable margin, so the reported IC50 values may be systematically low. We recalculated the curves using a solvent-matched control and obtained values roughly 1.4-fold higher. The authors are invited to respond. This letter presents no new experimental cohort of its own.
